name: Route Sign
description: One billboard sign anchored at a point along your route — set how far along the route, how far off to the side (metres), and how high (metres). One sign per ride.

settings.label: Side offset (m)
settings.description: Metres off the road centreline. Use + or − to pick the side (flip the sign to switch). ~2 = road edge, ~5 = clear.

settings.label: Show km marker
settings.description: Prints the sign's distance along the route (km) after the text

settings.label: Max distance (m)
settings.description: Hide the sign beyond this range from the camera · 0 = unlimited
